title: SimpleShop+
description: 🚀 SimpleShop — The ultimate, high-performance category-based market solution for Paper 1.20.1! Loaded with 100+ items, a sleek Auto-Pagination system  support to dominate your server's economy! 💎📦✨
body:
🛒 SimpleShop+ | The Ultimate Lightweight Economy Solution
Are you tired of bloated shop plugins that lag your server and confuse your players? Say hello to SimpleShop+ – the most intuitive, sleek, and high-performance shopping experience for modern Minecraft servers! 🚀
✨ Why Choose SimpleShop+?
SimpleShop+ is designed with one goal in mind: Efficiency. We’ve stripped away the complexity to give you a powerful GUI-based economy system that just works.
• ⚡ Blazing Fast: Optimized code ensures zero impact on your TPS.
• 🎨 Fully Customizable: Change every message, item, and price in seconds.
• 💎 Modern GUI: A clean, chest-based interface that players love.
• 🛠️ Easy Setup: Plug and play! No Ph.D. in configuration required.
• 🔄 Version Support: Works seamlessly with the latest Minecraft versions.
🚀 Features at a Glance
• [NEW] Category System: Organize your items into blocks, ores, food, and more! 📦
• Dynamic Pricing: Easily set buy and sell prices for any item. 💸
• Permission Control: Full support for LuckPerms and other permission managers. 🔐
• One-Click Buy/Sell: Interactive menus for a smooth trading experience. 🖱️
• Logging System: Keep track of your server's economy with built-in transaction logs. 📋
🛠️ Installation & Commands
Getting started is as easy as /shop!
1. Download the SimpleShop+.jar
2. Drop it into your /plugins folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Enjoy! 🎉
Commands:
• /shop - Opens the main shopping menu.
• /simpleshop reload - Reloads the configuration (Admin only).
🤝 Support & Feedback
Found a bug? Have a suggestion? We’d love to hear from you!
Join our community or open an issue on the GitHub page.
